description: An easy walk through a moss laden old growth forest. This 20 minute round trip hike winds through towering old growth Douglas fir trees toward the crystal waters of the Gold River.
directions: As you approach the Village of Gold River via Hwy 28, head straight through the junction (don't turn left into town). Turn right immediately before the bridge and head up the hill (gravel road). Take your first left at the junction following the Gold River Trail sign, head across the bridge and the parking area is a very short distance up the road on your left.
title: Gold River Trail
